text:
Sam (Hiring Manager): quick ask  candidate: Elena Park. Hiring requests comp-band exception + benefits start aligned to deferred part-time onboarding. Need to confirm routing for provisional uplift and bridging stipend. Packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/elena-park
Ria (People Ops): outline numbers and routing pls.
Jordan (Recruiter): Elena verbally accepted pending final offer. Shes finishing a contract and will start 2026-09-01 part-time (50%) for first 4 weeks, full-time 2026-09-29. Wants benefits from 9/1 or bridging stipend.
Sam (Hiring Manager): proposing L5->L6 provisional, base $165k -> $185k (+$20k), sign-on $10k split 50/50, bridging stipend equal to employee contribution up to $300 for month 1.
Priya (Finance): need GL and budget owner. Uplift $20k is at comp-committee threshold for review. Provide peer comps and manager justification.
Alex (Comp Committee): we can fast-track if manager note + comps attached. Also need VP signoff for provisional band >$15k.
Ria (People Ops): uploaded docs: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp/elena-justification.pdf
Legal (Legal): recommend clause for part-time start and bridging stipend; attach template.
hr-bot: policy: "Part-time onboarding exceptions require Comp Committee + Payroll coordination" (HR-PART-002). Template: /templates/parttime-bridging-stipend.docx
Alex (Comp Committee): approved (fast-track) pending VP Eng signoff.
Priya (Finance): GL: 6101.1400, budget owner: eng-platform. Finance provisioned pending Legal clause.
Legal (Legal): signed off on clause and clawback wording.
Sam (Hiring Manager): VP Eng confirmed in DM. Please send offer today and confirm benefits activation.
Ria (People Ops): routing summary: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> VP signoff complete. Offer to be sent at 14:00 PT. Closing thread once signed. :thumbsup:
